text: This report recommends that the name "Sandra Shamas Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located east of Shaw Street, extending southerly from Barton Avenue. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Sandra Shamas Lane" for an existing public lane located east of Shaw Street, extending southerly from Barton Avenue.
